subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Callous
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Callous"** means showing or having an insensitive and cruel disregard for others. (निर्दयी)

 
 
• **Example: **His **callous** comments about the accident shocked everyone.
 
 
 
• **"Cruel" **refers to someone who willfully causes pain or suffering to others, or feels no concern about it. (क्रूर)
 
 
• **Example: **She was known for her **cruel** treatment of her subordinates.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Callous'** is **'Cruel'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Generous **(उदार): Showing a readiness to give more of something, especially money, than is strictly necessary or expected.

 
 
• **Example:** He was generous with both his time and his money.
 
 
 
• **Exhausting **(थकाऊ ): Making one feel very tired; very tiring.
 
 
• **Example: **The exhausting climb left them all breathless.
 
 
 
• **Affectionate** (स्नेही): Readily feeling or showing fondness or tenderness.
 
 
• **Example:** She gave her friend an affectionate hug.
